mapper.sql: i.id, i.installation_id, i.plugin_id, i.instance_id, i.installation_name, d.version, d.display_name, d.main_class, d.runtime_engine, d.entry_point, d.execution_mode, d.artifact_path, d.artifact_sha256, i.runtime_type, i.state, i.runner_host, i.runner_port, i.work_dir, d.capabilities_json, d.config_schema_json, d.account_schema_json, d.dependency_jars_json, i.remote_debug_enabled, i.remote_debug_port, i.remote_debug_suspend, i.owner_user_id, u.username AS owner_username, i.owner_dept_id AS owner_department_id, dept.department_name AS owner_department_name, i.started_at, i.created_at, i.updated_at
FROM plugin_installation i JOIN plugin_definition d ON d.plugin_id = i.plugin_id LEFT JOIN sky_user u ON u.user_id = i.owner_user_id JOIN sky_department dept ON dept.department_id = i.owner_dept_id
mapper.select: SELECT WHERE i.installation_id = #{installationId} AND i.deleted = FALSE

SELECT
ORDER BY i.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT i.state AS status, COUNT(*) AS total AND i.deleted = FALSE GROUP BY i.state
mapper.sql: AND i.deleted = FALSE AND (i.installation_id LIKE #{keywordLike} OR i.installation_name LIKE #{keywordLike} OR i.plugin_id LIKE #{keywordLike} OR d.display_name LIKE #{keywordLike}) AND i.state = #{state} AND JSON_CONTAINS(d.capabilities_json, 'true', '$.task') AND JSON_CONTAINS(d.capabilities_json, 'true', '$.config') AND JSON_CONTAINS(d.capabilities_json, 'true', '$.account') AND JSON_CONTAINS(d.capabilities_json, 'true', '$.notification') AND JSON_CONTAINS(d.capabilities_json, 'true', '$.service')
mapper.select:
SELECT
ORDER BY i.installation_name, i.installation_id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE plugin_installation SET state=#{state}, runner_host=#{runnerHost}, runner_port=#{runnerPort}, work_dir=#{workDir}, started_at=#{startedAt}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE installation_id=#{installationId} AND deleted=FALSE

UPDATE plugin_installation SET remote_debug_enabled=#{enabled}, remote_debug_port=#{port}, remote_debug_suspend=#{suspend}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE installation_id=#{installationId} AND deleted=FALSE
UPDATE plugin_installation SET state='STOPPED', runner_port=NULL, started_at=NULL, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE state IN ('STARTING','RUNNING') AND deleted=FALSE
UPDATE plugin_installation SET deleted=TRUE, state='STOPPED', runner_port=NULL, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE installation_id=#{installationId} AND deleted=FALSE
mapper.select: SELECT channel_id FROM plugin_installation_channel WHERE installation_id=#{installationId} ORDER BY channel_id
SELECT DISTINCT jc.channel_id FROM job_notification_channel jc JOIN job j ON j.id=jc.job_id WHERE j.plugin_installation_id=#{installationId} ORDER BY jc.channel_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO plugin_installation_channel (installation_id, channel_id, created_by) VALUES (#{installationId}, #{channelId}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE plugin_installation SET owner_user_id=#{ownerUserId}, owner_dept_id=#{ownerDepartmentId}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE installation_id=#{installationId} AND deleted=FALSE
